tools.name: list_crops
tools.title: List crops
tools.description: List crops in the DHRUVA catalogue with optional text, category, season or district filters. Returns slug, name, season, soil, water need, profit % and expected yield.

query.description: Free-text match on crop or scientific name.

category.description: Category such as Cereal, Pulse, Millet, Oilseed, Cash, Spice, Vegetable, Fruit.

season.description: Season substring such as Kharif or Rabi.

district.description: District name to match against a crop's suitable districts.

trendingOnly.description: Only return crops flagged as trending.

tools.name: get_crop
tools.title: Get crop guide
tools.description: Get the full agronomy guide for one crop by slug: climate, soil, land preparation, seed rate, irrigation, fertilizer schedule, diseases, pests, harvesting, market price, rotation, tips and references.

slug.description: Crop slug, e.g. 'rice', 'cotton', 'chilli'. Use list_crops to discover slugs.

tools.name: get_districts
tools.title: Districts and their crops
tools.description: List Andhra Pradesh districts (region, headquarters, soil, climate) or get one district by slug along with the crops cultivated there.

slug.description: District slug for a single district. Omit to list all districts.

region.description: Filter list by region: Coastal, Rayalaseema or Uttarandhra.

tools.name: find_crop_diseases
tools.title: Crop disease lookup
tools.description: Look up crop diseases by crop slug and/or symptom keywords. Returns symptoms, cause, severity, and organic and chemical control measures from that crop's own disease library.

slug.description: Crop slug to restrict the search to one crop.

symptom.description: Keyword to match against disease name, symptoms or cause.

tools.name: calculate_fertilizer
tools.title: Fertilizer calculator
tools.description: Calculate the fertilizer quantities needed for a crop over a given land size, using that crop's own per-acre schedule. Returns per-acre and total kilograms per product and stage.

slug.description: Crop slug, e.g. 'rice'. Use list_crops to discover slugs.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.title: Live weather
tools.description: Get live weather and a 5-day forecast for a place (village, town, district or city). Uses the public Open-Meteo service — no personal location data is involved.

countryCode.description: ISO country code to disambiguate; defaults to IN.

tools.name: get_market_prices
tools.title: Live mandi prices
tools.description: Get live Indian mandi (market) prices per quintal from the public Agmarknet dataset on data.gov.in, filtered by state, district, market or commodity.

tools.name: query_knowledge_base
tools.title: Query Knowledge Base
tools.description: Searches the DHRUVA Knowledge Base for detailed agronomy, disease protocols, and regional production statistics. Use this for complex agricultural advisory queries.

query.description: Natural language query to search in the knowledge base.

limit.description: Number of relevant documents to return (default 5).
